Do not return hashes; the host binds immutable hashes.", "context": {"title": "David Copperfield", "unit": 30, "heading": "CHAPTER 28. Mr. MICAWBER’S GAUNTLET", "previous_rows": [{"source_id": "en85-u030-b0027", "target": "— Прошу вас, сэр, — почтительно отвечал он, — присесть и позволить мне это сделать. — С этими словами он взял вилку из моей не сопротивлявшейся руки и склонился над решёткой, словно всё его внимание было поглощено ею.", "source_sha256": "a7fcbd9f51bfcc0017cc013458b57a9ca1312bd7b2b1f4f8685fa0f726e30488", "target_id": "ru-en85-u030-b0027", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "90da971a74cc19070e3f00d8b7e01339562d2f1737ac740ef4e064334c01cfe3"}, {"source_id": "en85-u030-b0028", "target": "Появление самого Стирфорта вряд ли сильно смутило бы нас, смею сказать, но перед его респектабельным слугой мы в одно мгновение стали смирнее смирных. Мистер Микобер, напевая какой-то мотив, чтобы показать, что чувствует себя совершенно непринуждённо, опустился на стул, а ручка поспешно спрятанной вилки торчала у него из-за пазухи сюртука, будто он заколол себя. Миссис Микобер надела свои коричневые перчатки и приняла вид благородной томности. Трэдлс запустил жирные руки в волосы, поставил их торчком и в смущении уставился на скатерть. Что до меня, я был сущим младенцем во главе собственного стола и едва осмеливался взглянуть на респектабельное явление, пришедшее Бог знает откуда, чтобы навести порядок в моём хозяйстве.", "source_sha256": "e5d5be42fb3354f7bb6c17252f220f993183e2018b87c11aecc103a8613e6711", "target_id": "ru-en85-u030-b0028", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "89b85def18071ef38cfac3634f7f60fb8a44aed92ce9a7fa0596c9851ca37d3e"}], "source_language": "English", "part": null, "book": null, "chapter": 28, "role": "chapter"}, "source_rows": [{"id": "en85-u030-b0029", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "Meanwhile he took the mutton off the gridiron, and gravely handed it round. We all took some, but our appreciation of it was gone, and we merely made a show of eating it. As we severally pushed away our plates, he noiselessly removed them, and set on the cheese. He took that off, too, when it was done with; cleared the table; piled everything on the dumb-waiter; gave us our wine-glasses; and, of his own accord, wheeled the dumb-waiter into the pantry. All this was done in a perfect manner, and he never raised his eyes from what he was about. Yet his very elbows, when he had his back towards me, seemed to teem with the expression of his fixed opinion that I was extremely young.", "sha256": "16b9fccfde7f4a337edd0bee851e14c72c97ea00e3de15346fbf1b590d81dcf7", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[35]/p[30]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u030-b0030", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Can I do anything more, sir?’", "sha256": "a9ac0cfe1596cc7f61fc33448ae3ad8250b5d790dbff9262789e41a3e9d08dd6", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[35]/p[31]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u030-b0031", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "I thanked him and said, No; but would he take no dinner himself?", "sha256": "594cc5eab89535a856b219d10f72157a159100d918ab5943cd5e598b3f954f0a", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[35]/p[32]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u030-b0032", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘None, I am obliged to you, sir.’", "sha256": "cff0f5930d21a4212d775b24353e631ca0ff81707252ffb8b78276059078c5f2", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[35]/p[33]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u030-b0033", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Is Mr. Steerforth coming from Oxford?’", "sha256": "ba49d3165d60a5f0678009e1905e3871c528193f05d0ce51c93968223626a335", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[35]/p[34]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u030-b0034", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘I beg your pardon, sir?’", "sha256": "675ec7a7d64149228cd91d13e25f5cf580cf82c65979dcf08cc5bc623dcbe875", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[35]/p[35]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u030-b0035", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Is Mr. Steerforth coming from Oxford?’", "sha256": "ba49d3165d60a5f0678009e1905e3871c528193f05d0ce51c93968223626a335", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[35]/p[36]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u030-b0036", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘I should imagine that he might be here tomorrow, sir. I rather thought he might have been here today, sir. The mistake is mine, no doubt, sir.’", "sha256": "f05f1c52f1f78eb34351f389b496c8f65173c4f9e5173d72570a94fdb5a0c375", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[35]/p[37]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u030-b0037", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘If you should see him first—’ said I.", "sha256": "d856eea691698f4d2aa8496cb26728aedc022ec33e1e0cfb1a34ff770bfe239e", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[35]/p[38]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u030-b0038", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘If you’ll excuse me, sir, I don’t think I shall see him first.’", "sha256": "14cbb0fbba62f58fcb7e2aab00bb14872879b12a4867f018b3c9345443458fe4", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[35]/p[39]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u030-b0039", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘In case you do,’ said I, ‘pray say that I am sorry he was not here today, as an old schoolfellow of his was here.’", "sha256": "b564c2d340c903a8d559e89183bb1837cbca63e0225357f09d85f162825294fb", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[35]/p[40]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u030-b0040", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Indeed, sir!’ and he divided a bow between me and Traddles, with a glance at the latter.", "sha256": "10f2ee8e3326770a708b6c5978fe7b27c49e50873a5330a1d5f04c612a57bdaf", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[35]/p[41]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u030-b0041", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "He was moving softly to the door, when, in a forlorn hope of saying something naturally—which I never could, to this man—I said:", "sha256": "c1ef01feeda2f23d862fe6f50084e67fa7c7e033a6ce38e62c1954f9ef46dad9", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[35]/p[42]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u030-b0042", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Oh! Littimer!’", "sha256": "fc2d6d08cc76744b9a32b9ededa5ec1655a0179d3f3bbae8542559b6eabdbc71", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[35]/p[43]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u030-b0043", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Sir!’", "sha256": "b81548d6a137b9cb91c3e8310adefe111a48e8f10434d553e83970c1b462bf7c", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[35]/p[44]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u030-b0044", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Did you remain long at Yarmouth, that time?’", "sha256": "ed30ee97b841d1df2bc5636da319d1fdbf6894bda7548e740938bacc1b356d63", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[35]/p[45]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u030-b0045", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Not particularly so, sir.’", "sha256": "ed7089f190338aa87cfef0ce8df2e0dbe3b1ac73bbda98d0735ffda12425c188", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[35]/p[46]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u030-b0046", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘You saw the boat completed?’", "sha256": "88671c99ed36599cd531fbafd76598bde093ffb1c6794460ef5e67696f424d21", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[35]/p[47]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u030-b0047", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Yes, sir. I remained behind on purpose to see the boat completed.’", "sha256": "811c6f3ec719f2e7ca9e74bb34d034aa1f8c969d5149291170757d0aa682f039", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[35]/p[48]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u030-b0048", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘I know!’ He raised his eyes to mine respectfully.", "sha256": "28085cc6b8364793fb346fd568c2258a0876683286021502c9515402a4bdacd1", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[35]/p[49]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u030-b0049", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Mr. Steerforth has not seen it yet, I suppose?’", "sha256": "77c4ce1ae9f0cf93b4e0bea4c52db64c5da4778e439c5ce78ae96ba53d0d9f08", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[35]/p[50]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u030-b0050", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘I really can’t say, sir. I think—but I really can’t say, sir. I wish you good night, sir.’", "sha256": "53e669d7cfb0be7558eaa3c2319380f428212a8825d2f601f8809415f00cf34d", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[35]/p[51]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u030-b0051", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "He comprehended everybody present, in the respectful bow with which he followed these words, and disappeared. My visitors seemed to breathe more freely when he was gone; but my own relief was very great, for besides the constraint, arising from that extraordinary sense of being at a disadvantage which I always had in this man’s presence, my conscience had embarrassed me with whispers that I had mistrusted his master, and I could not repress a vague uneasy dread that he might find it out. How was it, having so little in reality to conceal, that I always DID feel as if this man were finding me out?", "sha256": "2bc06aafe59c8af70cc3322f6bd37689d3c1e29a29f601d33d08f5c217540436", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[35]/p[52]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u030-b0052", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "Mr. Micawber roused me from this reflection, which was blended with a certain remorseful apprehension of seeing Steerforth himself, by bestowing many encomiums on the absent Littimer as a most respectable fellow, and a thoroughly admirable servant. Mr. Micawber, I may remark, had taken his full share of the general bow, and had received it with infinite condescension.", "sha256": "dbcea31a7fc472d89e0110fdb748d42df83c4e42fd2d78ef04a2904f8fbfde7c", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[35]/p[53]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u030-b0053", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘But punch, my dear Copperfield,’ said Mr. Micawber, tasting it, ‘like time and tide, waits for no man. Ah! it is at the present moment in high flavour. My love, will you give me your opinion?’", "sha256": "6bb7cc121c8700f4ee8c9a41d6395eb1b1a555483817aade80497cc1c27063c4", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[35]/p[54]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u030-b0054", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "Mrs. Micawber pronounced it excellent.", "sha256": "d66d0fbde063d684849d338dcc3e7e3cabdf14b540ced7ddc06189e877ddc8ca", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[35]/p[55]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u030-b0055", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Then I will drink,’ said Mr. Micawber, ‘if my friend Copperfield will permit me to take that social liberty, to the days when my friend Copperfield and myself were younger, and fought our way in the world side by side. I may say, of myself and Copperfield, in words we have sung together before now, that", "sha256": "b99fbb0cdd3942e23492ccfdc33232ca56aacb6d7ee8b4baee633ce392d02f15", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[35]/p[56]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u030-b0056", "tag": "p", "role": "verse_group", "text": "We twa hae run about the braes\nAnd pu’d the gowans’ fine", "sha256": "2a3fa82d5fd786be6c1a140bb1b3c489968fc45dee4b0094462b2b91c5903c2f", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[35]/p[57]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_lines": ["We twa hae run about the braes", "And pu’d the gowans’ fine"], "source_class": "poem"}, {"id": "en85-u030-b0057", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "—in a figurative point of view—on several occasions. I am not exactly aware,’ said Mr. Micawber, with the old roll in his voice, and the old indescribable air of saying something genteel, ‘what gowans may be, but I have no doubt that Copperfield and myself would frequently have taken a pull at them, if it had been feasible.’", "sha256": "33c387e36fbffbbeb9d9f244c77631522f52d6b0205e2b0a0d088a7ef3b185c0", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[35]/p[58]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": "noindent"}, {"id": "en85-u030-b0058", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "Mr. Micawber, at the then present moment, took a pull at his punch. So we all did: Traddles evidently lost in wondering at what distant time Mr. Micawber and I could have been comrades in the battle of the world.", "sha256": "c5e4d1c5e33be33c68b5989baca953f6b98d3185ed0cd4ef765e8bbbc4815362", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[35]/p[59]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u030-b0059", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Ahem!’ said Mr. Micawber, clearing his throat, and warming with the punch and with the fire. ‘My dear, another glass?’", "sha256": "4953b990285f272a77719a6c1e6857c46d62c4db99367a03f25bdad157f5814e", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[35]/p[60]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u030-b0060", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "Mrs. Micawber said it must be very little; but we couldn’t allow that, so it was a glassful.", "sha256": "9e36a86939a061fa390b27e188eac39eb73dba63808892a291410d39cdfc07c0", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[35]/p[61]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}]}
